content.title: SoftBank in Talks to Buy Data-Center Investor DigitalBridge
content.summary: The Japanese conglomerate is negotiating a potential deal to buy New York-listed DigitalBridge and take it private, the people said, asking not to be identified because the information is confidential.  Shares of DigitalBridge, which had fallen 13% this year before Friday, rose 45% in New York trading for the their biggest-ever one-day gain.

content.title: SoftBank in talks to buy digital infra firm DigitalBridge, source says
content.summary: SoftBank is in talks to acquire digital infrastructure firm DigitalBridge, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters ​on Friday, as the Japanese conglomerate seeks to tap the firm's ‌AI-linked portfolio.  The deal could be struck by the end of the year, the source said. ‌DigitalBridge and SoftBank declined to comment.  Shares of DigitalBridge surged as much as 35%, hitting over a one-month high.
